due_total.sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(amount) * 100) AS INTEGER), 0) FROM receipts WHERE COALESCE(status, 'new') <> 'paid'

due_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE COALESCE(status, 'new') <> 'paid'

overdue_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM receipts WHERE status = 'overdue'

latest_total.sql: SELECT COALESCE(CAST(ROUND(SUM(amount) * 100) AS INTEGER), 0) FROM receipts WHERE period = (SELECT MAX(period) FROM receipts)

monthly_totals.sql: SELECT period AS month, CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) * 100) AS INTEGER) AS total FROM receipts WHERE period IS NOT NULL GROUP BY period ORDER BY period DESC LIMIT 12

by_address.sql: SELECT c.id AS id, CASE WHEN c.address GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][, ]*' THEN trim(substr(c.address, instr(c.address, ',') + 1)) ELSE c.address END AS name, c.alias AS alias, COUNT(r.id) AS receipts, CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.status, 'new') <> 'paid' THEN r.amount END), 0) * 100) AS INTEGER) AS due FROM addresses a JOIN addresses c ON c.id = COALESCE(a.canonical_id, a.id) LEFT JOIN receipts r ON r.address_id = a.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY due DESC, name

receipts.sql: SELECT r.id, CASE WHEN c.address GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][, ]*' THEN trim(substr(c.address, instr(c.address, ',') + 1)) ELSE c.address END AS address, p.name AS provider, s.name AS service, r.period, CAST(ROUND(r.amount * 100) AS INTEGER) AS amount, COALESCE(r.status, 'new') AS status FROM receipts r JOIN addresses a ON a.id = r.address_id JOIN addresses c ON c.id = COALESCE(a.canonical_id, a.id) LEFT JOIN providers p ON p.id = r.provider_id LEFT JOIN service_types s ON s.id = r.service_type_id WHERE (:status IS NULL OR COALESCE(r.status, 'new') = :status) ORDER BY r.period DESC, r.id DESC

receipt.sql: SELECT r.id, CASE WHEN json_valid(r.raw_text) THEN json_extract(r.raw_text, '$.payer_name') END AS payer, a.address AS address, p.name AS provider, s.name AS service, r.period, r.receipt_date, r.account_number, CAST(ROUND(r.amount * 100) AS INTEGER) AS amount, CAST(ROUND(r.amount_paid * 100) AS INTEGER) AS amount_paid, COALESCE(r.status, 'new') AS status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(r.file_path, '') = '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_file FROM receipts r JOIN addresses a ON a.id = r.address_id LEFT JOIN providers p ON p.id = r.provider_id LEFT JOIN service_types s ON s.id = r.service_type_id WHERE r.id = :id

receipt_services.sql: WITH src AS (SELECT raw_text FROM receipts WHERE id = :id AND json_valid(raw_text)) SELECT json_extract(j.value, '$.name') AS name, CAST(ROUND(CAST(json_extract(j.value, '$.amount') AS REAL) * 100) AS INTEGER) AS amount, json_extract(j.value, '$.unit') AS unit, json_extract(j.value, '$.volume') AS volume, json_extract(j.value, '$.tariff') AS tariff FROM src, json_each(src.raw_text, '$.services') j ORDER BY j.rowid

receipt_file.sql: SELECT file_path FROM receipts WHERE id = :id
